notes.title: VR tracking, VMC_Camera linkage
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185648/8e28c40f7de32758bd3c4ea7afef50c299b24b14.gif

In the FullBody Tracking environment, the camera can be freely manipulated in virtual space, so there are fewer restrictions than webcams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44185648/4070eded47f9efd1429cfaab86ce582b170f7075.png
 
- The full tracking setting of the VMC (Virtual Motion Capture) program must be set by default.
  - You need to install and activate the virtual webcam. After installing VMC_Camera in advanced settings, activate it.
  - Set the resolution to 640x480 / 60hz or 70hz and apply.
  - Please choose the most suitable calibration method for the environment you are using.
  - If you have room for a tracker, do not use the HMD on the head, manually assign the desired tracker and calibrate it.
  - In VMC, the background is not green or transparent (it is not recognized)
  - Set the camera to Free and position it so that it can be seen from a slightly higher position than the head in front of you in the virtual space.
  - Basically, it should be a humanoid VRM, and avoid excessive white or black (in-game tracking pops out)

notes.title: 06/22 Patch note
notes.content:
- Improved the UI for controlling with the mouse.
   (You can select an item item directly and drag/wheel is possible)
- Overlap guides are added in closets/shops, etc. You can turn it off in settings.
- Show motion guide when loading track list. You can turn it off in settings.
- Simplified the loading time of worn costumes.
- Fixed other bugs.
